name: smwgraphics-chrono-trigger-death-peak-mountains
title: Chrono Trigger - Death Peak (Mountains)
description:
A background seen while climbing the Death Peak, from Chrono Trigger. Unlike Denadoro variant, this one has some different details, like ruins of civilization nearby in the horizon. A good fit for snow or mountainous levels, in general.

Background scrolling must be disabled.

Credit would be great, but it is optional.
